title: Spider Silk Is Stronger Than Steel
description: Ounce for ounce, some spider silk is stronger than steel, and it can stretch too.

scenes.text: Spider silk can be stronger than steel.
scenes.subject: spider
scenes.say: [excited] Spider silk can be STRONGER than steel.

scenes.text: Compared weight for weight, some kinds of spider silk are stronger than steel.
scenes.subject: spider
scenes.say: Compared weight for weight, some kinds of spider silk are stronger than steel.

scenes.text: Unlike steel, it can also stretch a long way before it breaks. That is why a web can stop a flying insect without snapping.
scenes.subject: web
scenes.say: Unlike steel, it can also stretch a long way before it breaks. [chuckles] That is why a web can stop a flying insect without snapping.

scenes.text: Researchers have spent years trying to copy it, for things like medical stitches and lightweight protective gear.
scenes.say: Researchers have spent years trying to copy it, for things like medical stitches and lightweight protective gear.

scenes.text: One of the strongest materials on Earth is spun by a spider. Follow for more weird facts.
